question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_rental AS (
    SELECT r1.customer_id, r1.rental_id, r1.rental_date
    FROM rental r1
    WHERE r1.rental_date = (
        SELECT MIN(r2.rental_date)
        FROM rental r2
        WHERE r2.customer_id = r1.customer_id
    )
),
first_rental_with_rating AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        r.customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_rentals,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) as total_amount
    FROM rental r
    LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY r.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fro.rating,
    AVG(cs.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
    AVG(1.0 * cs.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_with_rating fro
JOIN customer_stats cs ON fro.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY fro.rating
ORDER BY fro.rating
